big_story.story_title: Stock Market Today: Dow Rises On Surprise Inflation Data; Cisco, AI Name Cerebras Plunge On Earnings
big_story.angle: Cerebras and Cisco earnings misses are exposing the gap between AI hype and actual unit economics—what does it mean when the infrastructure play can't deliver?

Fermi Energy finally hired a CEO after months of limbo—nuclear power for AI is the story, but the real question is whether a new leader can actually move the needle or just manage the burn.

AI boom is moving currency markets now—when your story is big enough to shift FX, you've either found something real or you're in a bubble that's about to get very expensive.
